errors.text_span: "Насипи продукти" с дял от 6.37%, "Други палети" с дял от 8.75%
errors.evidence: The description swaps the percentage values for two categories. According to the chart, "Насипни продукти" (Bulk products) is 8.75% and "Други палети" (Other pallets) is 6.37%.
The description incorrectly states that labels are inside "some of the sectors," when in fact all eight sectors have percentage labels inside them.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по размер в низходящ ред
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are sorted by size in descending order, which is not true. The sectors are not arranged in any specific order based on their value.

errors.text_span: оцветени в различни цветове и шарки
errors.evidence: The description states the sectors are distinguished by colors, but the chart is in black and white and uses patterns, not colors.
The description uses the grammatically incorrect term "Насипи продукти". The correct term from the legend is "Насипни продукти".
